result.justification: The research objective is clearly stated and directly linked to the methodology, which is detailed and allows reproducibility.

evidence.quote: This study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of Bacillus spp. consortia formulated in potato–sugar-based liquid media supplemented with three types of organic broths in controlling bacterial leaf blight.
The antagonistic activity of Bacillus spp. against the leaf blight pathogen was tested using the dual culture method.
